title: Not for US market
text: Not for US market. Sorry to say, but this product is useless for anyone living in the US. I was so excited to get the Braun Mixer, since I remember this brand to be awesome. The plug is for a European electrical system and not for US, either you have to buy an expensive converter or this won't work.
